checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open empty hands reach overhead; arms lift together or pull elbows toward the ribs according to the exercise.
checks.feet: Pelvis stays stable and both legs remain extended; legs lift together or maintain a hover according to the exercise.
checks.movement: Prone simultaneous arm, upper chest and straight leg lift. Stable pelvis and neutral neck. Raise gently for 3 seconds, pause 2 seconds, lower 3 seconds.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
